[](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=fe69280e6e&e=d842fb25cc)
| | | | | Peter,

We’re less than three weeks away from Election Day, and I want to address the devastating wildfires in North Dakota.

First, let me start by saying that our hearts and prayers go out to all those affected by the tragic loss of life, property, and livestock. The people of North Dakota are strong, and together, we will bounce back.

Unfortunately, some are using this terrible tragedy for political gain, and that’s nothing short of shameful.

There’s been talk that the wildfires highlight the need to vote NO on Measure 4. That claim is complete baloney, and it's an attempt to manipulate the good people of North Dakota by playing on fear.

**Let’s be clear : NOT ONE DOLLAR of funding for essential services, such as Rural Fire, Ambulance Services, and other critical needs, will be lost if Measure 4 passes.**

Every dollar currently funded by property taxes will be replaced by the state. Services will continue to be fully funded, and local control will remain intact.

**The idea that we’ll lose funding or that communities will suffer from tax relief is completely false**.

In fact, Measure 4 does the exact opposite — it REMOVES the burden of unfair property taxes and frees up local services from restrictive mill levies, allowing them to better meet future needs.

**Measure 4 ensures that we have** :

✅ Massive property tax relief✅ Full funding of essential services✅ Full local control

Now is not the time to let fear-mongering dictate our decisions. Let’s rise above the political football being played with this tragedy and make an informed choice that benefits all North Dakotans.

**Vote YES on Measure 4** to end the unfair property tax and ensure a brighter, more prosperous future for North Dakota.

LET’S WIN!

|
---

Captain Christopher Kuehne, US Marine Corps (retired) is a disabled combat veteran and a patriot.

He rose from Private to Captain, and was decorated twice for valor in combat. On his last deployment, a suicide bomber detonated his vest near him. It caused him terrible, permanent injuries resulting in a 100% disability rating.

Christopher is the kind of man you want as your next door neighbor. Or representing you in city hall or on Capitol Hill.

He went to Washington, DC on January 6, 2021 to protect peaceful protesters from being violently attacked by Antifa and Black Lives Matter thugs.

When he peacefully entered the US Capitol building, he attacked no one. He broke nothing.

You know what he did?

**Christopher picked up trash and tried to help the US Capitol Police. Earlier that day, he tried to save the life of a man who needed CPR.**

He then went back home to his wife, Annette, their little boy, Chris, and their unborn baby.

The US flag and Marine Corps flag flew out front, and a sign by the front door said "God Bless America."

It was the dead of winter in Kansas.

**And in the early morning on February 11, 2021, the FBI raided his home. They pointed their rifles at Annette and their little boy. They forced Annette to stand outside in 14-degree weather, barefoot, wearing only a tee shirt and shorts. The next day, she lost the baby.**

(Now Christopher doesn't blame the FBI for his child's death ... but I do.)

He was bulldozed by Joe Biden's corrupt Department of Justice, and forced to plead guilty to a felony he didn't commit, impeding law enforcement during a civil disorder ... or face serious jail time for multiple criminal charges.

**Christopher is serving 75 days in federal prison in San Diego right now. And I bet he isn 't getting all the medical care he needs for his traumatic brain injury and other serious injuries he suffered while serving our country.**

You and I know Christopher is one of many January 6 peaceful protesters who committed no crime. But they've been cruelly hunted, hounded, and harassed by the FBI and DOJ anyway.

Many more still face trial and long prison sentences, far from their families and friends.

Let me tell you, what's being done to Christopher and other innocent Americans is an outrage!

**But there 's something you can do about it.**

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 47 years.

You've probably seen me on cable news or heard me on talk radio.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win. And my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! And I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn't commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

body:
Patriot, I really did not want to make this TV ad sharing the story of how I learned my late wife had been killed while serving our nation in Syria. It's deeply personal and, as you might imagine, a painful memory. However, I believe it's important that voters understand the experiences I've had that I'll bring with me to Congress. I invite you to watch this ad here: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Shannon](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/763i9WXiRaaOMGdV0XG2pVeA/yQjj8921dl5tymwyordBxJzg). Right now, cash is really tight, and we're trying to raise the money we need to get this ad on the air. If you believe it's important that we get this message out, so voters can learn who the real me is in a way that cuts through the $13 million in attack ads that have been launched against me so far (with many millions more to come), I urge you to donate whatever you can spare at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/nSQEzZZlEykdoQAj0PIF1g/yQjj8921dl5tymwyordBxJzg). ## **Updates Assistance, and Things You Can Do Right Now to Impact Our Upcoming Election**

### UPDATE: North Carolina Report from the Front Lines
I spent the past week travelling across the most devastated parts of North Carolina. What we saw was ... the best of American resilience. The best of Americans helping Americans.

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:

Peter,
October is nearly halfway over, and when this month ends, there will only be 5 days left until Election Day. So we’re coming to you with some concerning news: We’re currently _**behind**_ on our October fundraising goal!
**[Pitch in to help us catch up](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241014-1?amount=3&refcode=em20241014-1-4392&refcode2=4392_420207_UWqLnx&akid=4392%2E420207%2EUWqLnx)**

Captain Christopher Kuehne, US Marine Corps (retired) is a disabled combat veteran and a patriot.

He rose from Private to Captain, and was decorated twice for valor in combat. On his last deployment, a suicide bomber detonated his vest near him. It caused him terrible, permanent injuries resulting in a 100% disability rating.

Christopher is the kind of man you want as your next door neighbor. Or representing you in city hall or on Capitol Hill.

He went to Washington, DC on January 6, 2021 to protect peaceful protesters from being violently attacked by Antifa and Black Lives Matter thugs.

When he peacefully entered the US Capitol building, he attacked no one. He broke nothing.

You know what he did?

**Christopher picked up trash and tried to help the US Capitol Police. Earlier that day, he tried to save the life of a man who needed CPR.**

He then went back home to his wife, Annette, their little boy, Chris, and their unborn baby.

The US flag and Marine Corps flag flew out front, and a sign by the front door said "God Bless America."

It was the dead of winter in Kansas.

**And in the early morning on February 11, 2021, the FBI raided his home. They pointed their rifles at Annette and their little boy. They forced Annette to stand outside in 14-degree weather, barefoot, wearing only a tee shirt and shorts. The next day, she lost the baby.**

(Now Christopher doesn't blame the FBI for his child's death ... but I do.)

He was bulldozed by Joe Biden's corrupt Department of Justice, and forced to plead guilty to a felony he didn't commit, impeding law enforcement during a civil disorder ... or face serious jail time for multiple criminal charges.

**Christopher is serving 75 days in federal prison in San Diego right now. And I bet he isn 't getting all the medical care he needs for his traumatic brain injury and other serious injuries he suffered while serving our country.**

You and I know Christopher is one of many January 6 peaceful protesters who committed no crime. But they've been cruelly hunted, hounded, and harassed by the FBI and DOJ anyway.

Many more still face trial and long prison sentences, far from their families and friends.

Let me tell you, what's being done to Christopher and other innocent Americans is an outrage!

**But there 's something you can do about it.**

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 47 years.

You've probably seen me on cable news or heard me on talk radio.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win. And my critical new lawsuit is a game changer.

**Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice BROKE THE LAW and ILLEGALLY SPIED ON LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS ... and I can PROVE it in court! That means their criminal convictions can be THROWN OUT. And their criminal trials can be THROWN OUT.**

And I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

Let me tell you, no other legal group in the country is doing what Freedom Watch is doing to defend and free January 6 patriots.

You see, many defense lawyers are scared spitless of the FBI and DOJ. So they tell their clients to plead guilty to crimes they didn't commit ... and they end up in prison.

But Freedom Watch fights!

(Italian Flag Raising at Greenwich Town Hall - Thanks to Tod Laudonia and the St. Lawrence Society)
I just want to wish everyone a very Happy Columbus Day and the celebration of a man who took a risk in search of the New World and was successful.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..UYLvKa0d-I-2hmPhlsBncNqHVLEBbnqBMzaG5qNJBGo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150218466)
He was the first to discover the the New World and set into motion the American dream: _**those who take risks are rewarded when they are well thought out and have a little luck and faith on their side.**_
Columbus said it even better: **" You can never cross the ocean unless you have the courage to lose sight of the shore."**

This holiday is much an American holiday, as it is a celebration for Italians.
**
We Cannot Let Our Nation 's History from Being Eroded**
With this holiday, it is a time in this country where history has been and is being eroded. In Connecticut and this country, Columbus Day has been removed from the calendar. In addition, there are also school holidays that have been removed as well. Earlier this year, in Stanford, Connecticut, the board of education took away the school holidays of Veterans Day and Columbus Day.
We went with other republican local elected officials and republican candidates to protest this with a group of passionate Italian-Americans, Veterans and even some Italian-American Veterans to make our voices heard. These officials included State Senator Ryan Fazio, State Representative Tom O'Dea and candidates Tina Courpas, and Rudy Settimi. Not to make this political, but there were no democrats present. See more here "First They Came For....... Our Veterans And Our Italian Americans In Stamford" (see [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6a0cc4b3-61bb-4107-8e44-b36ae09848bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **These individuals are all on Row B this November as they stand up for the truth and our history.**

This is America. We celebrate our history for better or worse. Those who do not learn history are condemned to repeat it. The last four years have seen a massive erosion of our American history.

In the wake of the riots, there has been a desecration of many statutes of Columbus and calls for their removal. Many of these monuments were paid for by members of various Italian-American organizations and one reason for them was to demonstrate resilience to the discrimination experienced by many Italian immigrants.
Many Italian immigrants faced immense opposition here in America. Their support and honor of Columbus as one of their own has helped to establish a stronger relationship with the historical involvement of Italians in the development of the Americas long before the English.
There are many with long-standing ties to the fabric of our great nation. On this day, let's celebrate Italian-Americans vast contribution to this country despite massive discrimination. Let us also appreciate their ability to overcome by persevering and conviction with a little faith to carry on Columbus's determination. His success became the foundation of the American Dream before we had a nation.
Here is a quick video I took in front of a Columbus statute yesterday (_it was not a speech at any club just used the podium as it was conveniently placed in front of a statute in Norwalk_).
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4f00debb-90f8-481a-96cc-4c255f957eac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Columbus also said - "Life has more imagination then we carry in our dreams." Well lets make some history this November by electing candidates that fully support the American Dream and the courage of Columbus.
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support. We could really use it to get the message out to many others.

For many Americans, the second Monday in October brings back memories of childhood poems and classroom celebrations of Columbus Day. Growing up in the 1990s, I still recall the rhyme we were taught to commemorate Christopher Columbus "discovering" America:
🎶A long time ago in 1492🎶
🎶Columbus sailed the ocean blue🎶
🎶He sailed and he sailed til America he found🎶
🎶Helped Columbus prove the world was round🎶
Except, none of this was true. As we mature and reflect on history with a more critical eye, it's essential to recognize that much of what we learned about Columbus was deeply flawed--if not outright propaganda. It's time we take a hard look at the truth behind Columbus's legacy and why celebrating Indigenous Peoples' Day is not just appropriate but necessary. **Let 's Address This.**

## Myth vs. Reality: The Columbus We Were Taught
The narrative that Columbus was a brave explorer who set out to prove the Earth was round and "discovered" America is simply false. Columbus wasn't on a mission to expand scientific understanding. The ancient Greeks proved the world was round thousands of years before Columbus, as did Muslim scientists centuries before him. Nor did Columbus "find" a new world unknown to the rest of humanity. Some historians like Ivan Van Sertima argue that [African explorers arrived in North America well before European explorers](https://substack.com/redirect/401e8324-f635-4048-a159-a16949bdfd41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--except they didn't engage in colonization. Moreover, Indigenous peoples had lived in the Americas for tens of thousands of years--[recent scholarship suggests as long as 33,000 years or more](https://substack.com/redirect/f6d2141b-2ad8-4e6e-bc8c-de86ca1f2024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--so to call them "found" is patently absurd.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/997af2dc-9765-42c9-815e-71291808828c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Moreover, celebrating a "Columbus Day," when Columbus never once set foot in what we now call the United States is also nonsensical. The myth of his connection to the U.S. is a fabrication, and it is important to remember that when Columbus landed in the Caribbean, he wasn't acting out of a noble spirit of discovery. He was seeking wealth and glory, with a brutal indifference to the lives of the people he encountered. This is not my opinion, but his own stated intentions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9305af9c-2d2c-4ad4-a571-fd1a5f68dafc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

## A Genocidal Legacy
In a recent interview, NBA coach Gregg Popovich aptly described Columbus as a man who "initiated a genocide," condemning the way the holiday ignores the atrocities committed against Indigenous peoples. Popovich's blunt remarks are a needed reality check for those who still celebrate Columbus.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c26ca017-02ba-468d-9767-2b31a50f8978?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And yes, Coach Pop is not some premier historian on this issue, but he's citing facts. And the facts speak for themselves when we look at Columbus's stated intentions. Columbus's own writings show that his voyages were driven by a desire to convert Indigenous people to Christianity, by any means necessary. In his journal, he describes his mission to spread Christianity and praises the expulsion of Jews and Muslims from Spain, demonstrating a fervent commitment to conquest and subjugation. Columbus wrote in his journal to King Ferdinand and Queen Isabella:
> Your Highnesses, as Catholic Christians and Princes who love the holy Christian faith, and the propagation of it, and who are enemies to the sect of Mahomet and to all idolatries and heresies, resolved to send me, Cristobal Colon, to the said parts of India to see the said princes...with a view that they might be converted to our holy faith...Thus, after having turned out all the Jews from all your kingdoms and lordships...your Highnesses gave orders to me that with a sufficient fleet I should go to the said parts of India...I shall forget sleep, and shall work at the business of navigation, so that the service is performed (Borne, 1906: 76).
Rather than bringing enlightenment, Columbus brought enslavement, rape, mutilation, and genocide to the Indigenous people he encountered. Honoring such a man with a national holiday is not only inappropriate, it's a grave injustice to the millions of Native Americans who suffered and continue to suffer as a result of his actions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8f9375f6-b447-4275-959e-f8be11665247?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

## The Shift Toward Indigenous Peoples' Day
According to the [Smithsonian](https://substack.com/redirect/f78d5742-7954-4156-b392-91be83de4bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Indigenous Peoples' Day "_recognizes that Native people are the first inhabitants of the Americas_ " and highlights their long-standing contributions to society. This shift in narrative is a crucial step toward correcting centuries of injustice and erasure. Indeed, we must additionally take meaningful steps to support Indigenous Peoples--[here are seven things you can do today](https://substack.com/redirect/f615e85f-897f-4ec7-81ea-133e975cd69b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And to be sure, Columbus Day is not some ancient American tradition--it has only been a federal holiday since 1937. Back when President Jimmy Carter was 13 years old! Thankfully today, more and more states are rejecting Columbus Day in favor of Indigenous Peoples' Day. As of today, at least 17 states and Washington, D.C., have replaced Columbus Day with a day that honors the original inhabitants of the Americas.
This change represents an important shift in how we acknowledge history. Indigenous Peoples' Day isn't just a symbolic gesture--it's a recognition of the ongoing genocide, displacement, and discrimination Indigenous peoples have faced for centuries. It's a call to remember the rich histories and cultures of the Native Americans who lived in these lands long before Columbus set sail.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8613d816-6187-4de6-9d72-854d361ef222?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Dignity Statute in South Dakota, a 50 foot tall statute in honor of the Lakota and Dakota people. "_Dignity represents the courage, perseverance and wisdom of the Lakota and Dakota culture in South Dakota. My hope is that the sculpture might serve as a symbol of respect and promise for the future. " -- Dale Lamphere, Sculptor of The Dignity Statue_

## The Path Forward: Learning and Honoring Truth
So, what should we do with Columbus? He should absolutely be taught about--but accurately. He was a historical figure who committed mass genocide, rape, and enslavement. These are facts, not interpretations. Teaching history honestly is the first step toward healing and understanding. Celebrating Columbus does nothing to further our understanding of America's history or its native peoples. Instead, it perpetuates harmful myths and erases the suffering of those who were victimized by his actions.
It's long past time for the United States to reject Columbus Day and fully embrace Indigenous Peoples' Day. Celebrating Indigenous Peoples' Day is not just about correcting historical wrongs. It's about recognizing the resilience and contributions of Native Americans and creating space for a more truthful understanding of American history. This holiday serves as an opportunity for reflection, learning, and respect for the people who were the original stewards of this land. Rather than celebrating a figure who represents the worst aspects of colonialism, we should spend this day learning about the cultures, histories, and ongoing struggles of Indigenous peoples.

Many Latin American/Hispanic Americans have Indigenous roots, reminding us that colonization has deeply impacted communities throughout the Americas. Today and all days, we affirm that all people deserve dignity, no matter their place of birth, immigration status, or ethnicity. **Nearly 1 in 5 U.S. residents, about 64 million people, have Latin American/Hispanic heritage.** More than half identify as multi-racial. But the stories and history of the people of Latin America and the Caribbean are too often left out of our dominant cultural narratives and out of our schools’ textbooks. That’s why **I want to**[**lift up the** **Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoSBoJrCjv5kOU99oGZgblxC8bGJ_2gQCiqXfNu12_fT6Iitg1hHOc0lEJPhMQ99Mv1p6xvzcYADTtB26BaTK9oqSkIId5BWoGVOcaVlnM6zsF_UQ64YoSKJ3bbynUoXJ7xM2Dg1evg8lnudHP-qtUmEDg9p6i8D5Xa8iIdjb1ocK2e8xDdiZLb-mnh6FCI0Cjt0fq-r-IzwBRnTFAD7J5dHc2cgwx4Sqr8SDm-hxBw9zReScu4S57lGciHM9sh3nc_6SoQWsJ64293TbYHGkXmY7I5w06nlU8jlxiOVDBIuTNPlVUDvowaGCGaIFk5qvjcY4IXgXJPANte4CxMtJtPvF2rqITMjj3g_uZ75Urw7M/4al/uKDxjGcPTW212Sm-hmhbvA/h1/h001.RD-XW0a41wNNBRQMrydNYN0CHQqFzewCYMfnDoRWn5s)**, which supports 5,000 youth and their families each year, including through powerful youth programs in Detroit’s schools.** Over 80% of the organization’s staff members were born and raised in Southwest Detroit, and 40% are graduates of DHDC’s programs. They run **after-school and summer youth programs** that engage K-12 students with hands-on experience and training in applied math and science, 3D design and printing, computer programing, robotics, electronics and engineering, marketing, music and video production, and graphic design. This work has helped**** to **develop robotics programs in every high school in Southwest Detroit** , and they’re expanding to middle and elementary schools. **Throughout the year, professional engineers mentor youth in these programs.** Already,**** young people in these programs have gone on to attain a degree in engineering and secure steady employment. clean_body: More than 63 million Americans have Latin American/Hispanic heritage and many have Indigenous roots as well. | | | Friend, Today is Indigenous Peoples’ Day and nearly the last day of National Hispanic Heritage Month. Many Latin American/Hispanic Americans have Indigenous roots, reminding us that colonization has deeply impacted communities throughout the Americas. Today and all days, we affirm that all people deserve dignity, no matter their place of birth, immigration status, or ethnicity. Nearly 1 in 5 U.S. residents, about 64 million people, have Latin American/Hispanic heritage. More than half identify as multi-racial. But the stories and history of the people of Latin America and the Caribbean are too often left out of our dominant cultural narratives and out of our schools’ textbooks. That’s why I want to, which supports 5,000 youth and their families each year, including through powerful youth programs in Detroit’s schools. Over 80% of the organization’s staff members were born and raised in Southwest Detroit, and 40% are graduates of DHDC’s programs. They run after-school and summer youth programs that engage K-12 students with hands-on experience and training in applied math and science, 3D design and printing, computer programing, robotics, electronics and engineering, marketing, music and video production, and graphic design. This work has helped** to develop robotics programs in every high school in Southwest Detroit , and they’re expanding to middle and elementary schools. Throughout the year, professional engineers mentor youth in these programs. Already, young people in these programs have gone on to attain a degree in engineering and secure steady employment. And this is just one part of the life-changing services and opportunities provided by the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation for our community’s self-empowerment and self-determination, education, workforce development, financial literacy, and more. | Thank you for continuing to build a world where everyone can thrive. I grew up in Southwest Detroit, home to one of the largest Latin American communities in Michigan. I still remember going to the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation as a young organizer, which helped shape my values as a justice seeker. This is why I am hoping you can help shape the next generation of young organizers through your support of the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation. The Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation (DHDC) is rooted in the vibrant culture of Detroit’s Latin American community, supporting over 5,000 youth and adults annually with life-changing opportunities for self-empowerment and self-determination, education, workforce development, financial literacy, and more. As part of providing high-quality and culturally competent services for the community, over 80% of DHDC’s staff members were born and raised in Southwest Detroit, and 40% of staff are graduates of DHDC’s programs. Right now , which engage K-12 students with hands-on experience and training in applied math and science, 3D design and printing, computer programing, robotics, electronics and engineering, marketing, music and video production, and graphic design. name: The Federalist Wire
subject: We’re letting them know who’s in charge
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Fellow Patriot,

We did it! We reached another
milestone!

Well, not what you're probably
expecting. Likely a far more grim, despicable milestone.

We've topped $35,000,000,000,000
in our national debt. (That's $35 trillion if that's too many
zeros to count).

The debt is rising faster and
faster, reaching new milestones every few months. We remember
when headlines buzzed after the debt exceeded $34 trillion.

Now's the time to sign the
Convention of States petition to end this fiscal insanity.

We aren't asking for something
crazy- just responsible spending and limited government. Basic
concepts to those outside Capitol Hill.

Imagine what it's like to spend
$1 trillion in just a few months. No individual can possibly
fathom that. Not even Elon Musk, the richest man in the world.
Not even the government bureaucrats who authorize the spending.

Have you noticed the pattern?
Democrat or Republican, in the majority or minority, nothing
changes.

The debt clock doesn't stop
climbing and neither do politicians' net worths.

We've bought the bogus talking
points for long enough, which is why Convention of States is
taking legitimate action in every state legislature. The federal
government does not listen to the people, so we're going around
the feds.

Will you stand with us as we work
to call the first-ever Article V convention to hold D.C.
accountable? Take one minute to sign the Convention of States
petition TODAY.

We will let them know who's in
charge, and it starts with signing the COS petition.

For America's future,

The Convention of States Action
Team

Team,
Recently, a new bill called was introduced to Congress that could completely reinvent housing in America. The Homes Act could help build and preserve as many as 1.3 million homes in small towns, big cities, and rural communities, and help families everywhere find a quality, affordable place to call home.
That sounds _amazing_ , so why aren’t we celebrating?
**It hasn’t passed yet.**
But just look at the numbers; if this bill passes, we could:
* **Build 1,252,000 new homes**
* **Generate 427,000 new jobs _annually_**
* **Help millions of minimum-wage workers find affordable places to live**

Every day, families nationwide are grappling with the housing crisis. All too often, people are forced to choose between paying rent and paying for food or medication. **_All of that could change if the Homes Act passes._** Housing is a basic human right, end of story. That's why it's mission critical that young voters like us step up and make our voices heard. So we have to ask:

Dear Peter,

Thank you for your support! Because of you, Students for Life Action got our commercial spotlighting how Kamala Harris voted twice to stop babies born after botched abortions from getting lifesaving medical care broadcast on Fox News.

During the VP debate, no less! It was viewed by over 7 million Americans.

It was viewed by over 7 million Americans!

I’d like you to speak with a member of my team about our urgent plans to expand the reach of this ad to key voter demographics online down the stretch this October.

Can my Partnerships Officer Nichole Merseth reach you by phone this Thursday the 17th at 2pm EST for just 20 minutes?

If that time doesn’t work, please just call or text my scheduler, Abigail Payne, at (540) 413-4871 and she will get you set up at a time that works for you.

Thanks for your reply! I really want you to hear our urgent plans these last few weeks and get your feedback and buy in.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Dear Peter,

Just moments ago, I made a MAJOR announcement on Charlie Kirk’s podcast . . .

As you may have seen on Tuesday night’s Presidential Debate, Kamala Harris flat-out REFUSED to name any abortion restriction she’d support.

And ABC “fact checked” Donald Trump by trying to claim that late term abortions and infanticide don’t exist.

Peter, this is the opening you and I need to show voters what the truth really is about the state of abortion in America and what Kamala Harris is really all about. . . abortion extremism.

That’s why Students for Life Action just unveiled a brand-new TV commercial we’re hoping to plaster around the internet and run on primetime cable TV news –
if you agree to your most generous contribution to help us put it on the air
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xKwtr9TSvLyMol1eXn1-CA~~/AAVkMwA~
!

You can see the ad by clicking
HERE
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/zLv41rz5PT5TUdBkJqZfqA~~/AAVkMwA~~~
.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/7TLr4RHx9FDR0qCcks3xIg~~/AAVkMwA~

After you do, please help us ensure EVERY voter in Battleground States sees this with your most generous gift!

>> $1,000 will ensure at least 250 voters see this ad on TV
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/gjmSU7GItgJsbj9mkS31YQ~~/AAVkMwA~
;

>> $360 will ensure 1,000 voters see this ad on YouTube
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/aCbzSo_ARAbJ0btaAMjxrg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo79NXP4Q_~
;

>> $120 will ensure 500 voters see this ad on Facebook and Instagram
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jg_2exrdw8yAY43T8cmIog~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo79NXP4Q_~
;

>> $50 will ensure 10 voters see this ad on TV
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/74I8ebXBk8xRjtEy1U9q-Q~~/AAVkMwA~
;

>> $5 will ensure 1 voter sees this ad on TV or 20 voters see it on social media
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ulZQ4xr1hx8PpTZVQm0bHQ~~/AAVkMwA~~
;

It’s no secret to you and me that the Harris-Walz Ticket is the most radically pro-abortion duo in U.S. history.

But many Americans – who only get their news from places like ABC – don’t know just HOW radical they really are.

It’s up to you and me to expose them.

This is why I personally wrote and produced this commercial.

Because we must fight back.

The second any sane person sees this ad, their jaw will drop to the floor in disbelief, and they’ll be instantly turned against the Harris-Walz abortion agenda.

But voters will only be able to see this ad as long as I can count on you to help me air it
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/JCPQU2J7ofXvlwayFH1gtw~~/AAVkMwA~
!

We cannot stand by as the mainstream media, Democrats, and the Abortion Lobby fill our TV screens and social media with their lies and garbage.

Kamala Harris and Tim Walz would rather voters didn’t know about their track record on abortion and infanticide – which is all the more reason you and I MUST expose them!

So, even though spending six figures for a national TV commercial wasn’t in my already tight Students for Life Action budget this fall, as we already have staff sleeping on couches instead of hotels and student door-knockers eating a strict and cheap pizza-only diet, I knew I had to take a risk and ask for your help.

So please consider giving $1,000, $360, $120, $50, or even $5 to hold Vice President Kamala Harris accountable for her abortion extremism
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/bjl-yDzaOakPEKStgQ6rVw~~/AAVkMwA~
!

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

body:
| Hi Peter, When was the last time you stopped at McDonald's? What about Taco Bell, Chipotle, or Jimmy John's? If it's been a while, your next fast food bill could be _shocking_.1 That's because these restaurants have doubled or even tripled their prices in recent years.1 So, it's now double-digit prices for Big Macs, burritos, and other fast food.1 When will it stop and how far can it go?
---
|
---
[**Click here to see it!**](https://financeinsights.net/Xn17iQKGlUGZJkbf34qdGu7dz5L?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Food inflation isn't exclusive to fast food or dining out options. It's also not a phenomenon that's underpinned by just one factor. One flip of the switch can't "solve" inflation or stop the snowballing price hikes. Instead, inflation's tied to multiple factors. To get a greater understanding of those potential factors, let's take a look at inflation through the lens of a tuna roll. [**Want to read more about tuna rolls & inflation? Click here to check out the rest.**](https://financeinsights.net/Xn17iQKGlUGZJkbf34qdGu7dz5L?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Warmly,
---
**Reid Rasner - CEO**
Omnivest Financial
(307) 337-1223

_**Socialist Democrats are on a mission to turn Texas from RED to BLUE!**_

I also want to make this clear: I don’t expect you or anyone else to donate just because our fundraising slowed down at a bad moment.
I’m asking for your support because I’m hoping that, if I lay out why I’m so passionate about this team, this mission, and this work, you’ll believe in this cause strongly enough to contribute your hard-earned money toward its success.
**The fact is, I’m running for re-election proudly on my record of getting big things done for Kansas families.**
By prioritizing results over partisanship and extremism, we’ve saved Kansans on Medicare $620 per year on insulin, created over 20,000 clean-energy jobs here in KS-03, and brought in millions of dollars for rural communities in Kansas to expand broadband access, ensure clean water, and fix aging roads and bridges.
**I’m also proud to be breaking the mold for what people picture when they picture a member of Congress.**
Here’s a brief snapshot of my life before I started serving in Washington: I was raised by a single mom and was the first person from my family to attend college. I juggled multiple jobs to pay my way through school. I then worked in economic and community development on Native American reservations. And when I flipped a Republican-held seat, it made me the first LGBTQ+ Native American elected to Congress.
**And I’m proud to be fighting hard for our values every single day.**
We’re up against extremists who are trying to take away abortion rights, to make life harder for LGBTQ+ Americans, to reduce access to affordable health care, and to undermine our democracy. I’m not afraid to stand up to them and defend our fundamental freedoms — but the reality is, if we’re going to win this fight, we need to flip control of the House. _**And there’s no realistic world in which we flip control of the House without defending this battleground House seat here in KS-03.**_

Have a great weekend!
-Sharice

Peter, I never grew up thinking that one day I would run for office in America, but here we are. I immigrated to this country when I was just four years old. My family and I escaped Vietnam after my father was put on a kill list by the Communist Party. We started a new life in America, and I learned how amazing this country is. We had freedoms and opportunities we previously couldn’t have even dreamed of. I owe my life to America - and that’s why I served for 25 years in combat as a Navy Captain to repay my duty to this country. When I finally retired from service, I planned to settle into a quiet life with my family here in Virginia. _But then, everything changed._ I saw what Joe Biden and Kamala Harris were doing to our great country, and I couldn’t help but be reminded of the horrors my family left in Vietnam so many years ago. Biden and Kamala were marching us down the dangerous path of socialism, and I had to do something about it. **That****’****s why I stepped up and decided to run for office.** The career politicians in Washington DC have let us down, and it’s time for leadership that truly understands what it’s like to serve. [**I****’****m ready to be that leader for our Commonwealth and our country but I need your support. Hi Peter,
Last week, I had my second — and final — debate against my opponent.
It was a critical moment to reach AZ-06 voters, because the next day, early voting started in Arizona.
Just like in our previous debate, my opponent was on the defensive.
He said he supports border security, but he walked away from the bipartisan border bill after Trump withdrew support.
He said he supports Social Security and Medicare, but he voted to slash the Social Security administration’s budget by hundreds of millions of dollars.
He said he supports women, but he tried to ban abortion access around the country and cheered when Roe was overturned.
It’s clear my opponent is too busy supporting Donald Trump’s agenda to focus on Arizonans. But with voting officially underway, we need your support to get that message out.
Mike Johnson’s super PAC just announced their plans to direct even more spending into our district. This is already one of the most competitive races in the country, so I have to ask: can you donate now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_101424_EV_actrs]

| | In the years since the creation of Social Security, the landmark legislation evolved into a euphemism for retirement benefits. But it is more than just a monthly check for retirees – **it is a safety net for**** _everyone_****that provides financial stability and peace of mind throughout life.** Social Security includes: **Retirement Security:** The most common connotations of Social Security are the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in your golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. **Disability Protection:** Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. **Survivor Benefits:** Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. **Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital.** The safety net from Social Security works in tandem with health care.**I believe health care is a right, and I have fought to make healthcare more affordable and accessible.** Right now, the Affordable Care Act is more popular than ever with 9 million Americans who buy insurance through the ACA Marketplace. **This November, we must elect leaders who will fight for Washingtonians and the millions of Americans who benefit from the provisions of the ACA.** We need leaders who will _expand_ access to high-quality, affordable health care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets — not 'replace it.' We need leaders who will continue to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, by imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for Medicare enrollees — and that is just the beginning. The progress we have made in areas such as Social Security and health care is being threatened in this election. **We have worked hard, we have more work to do, and we are not going backward.** More soon, _Rick_ | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:

Social Security includes: Retirement Security: The most common connotations of Social Security are the safeguards for the retired. It ensures that your hard work is rewarded with a reliable income stream in your golden years. It is a promise of dignity and independence after a lifetime of work and contributions to your community's economy. Disability Protection: Life is unpredictable, and an unexpected disability can lead to financial strain. Social Security includes disability benefits that offer a lifeline to protect you and your family during challenging times. Survivor Benefits: Tragedy can strike, leaving loved ones in dire financial straits. Social Security provides crucial support to surviving spouses and dependents, easing the burden and helping them move forward. Whether you are nearing retirement or just starting your career, understanding and supporting Social Security is vital. The safety net from Social Security works in tandem with health care.I believe health care is a right, and I have fought to make healthcare more affordable and accessible. Right now, the Affordable Care Act is more popular than ever with 9 million Americans who buy insurance through the ACA Marketplace. This November, we must elect leaders who will fight for Washingtonians and the millions of Americans who benefit from the provisions of the ACA. We need leaders who will expand access to high-quality, affordable health care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets — not 'replace it.' We need leaders who will continue to lower the costs of prescription drugs. I voted to reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, by imposing a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation, and by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for Medicare enrollees — and that is just the beginning. The progress we have made in areas such as Social Security and health care is being threatened in this election. We have worked hard, we have more work to do, and we are not going backward. We’re approaching our FINAL mid-month benchmark ahead of Election Day. This is an important checkpoint with 22 days left and ballots already out. **[Will you chip in $3, then read on about why we can’t let up now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95006377/505270690/2104826962?refcode=em-10.14.24-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTNmNmU5Yy01MzhhLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-sPu828Z63Z2ddi3hKeLohZjsAPc2QGR7uNaP36sIFU=)**

* **Mike Garcia is a far-right extremist who has no business representing this district in Congress.** From co-sponsoring national abortion ban legislation to voting to give himself a pay raise while voting down a raise for firefighters, his actions show just how out of touch he is with the community.

* **The good news is, Garcia is extremely vulnerable and we’re holding a slight lead in the polls.** Political experts rate our race as a pure toss-up for House control, with some outlets ranking CA-27 as “Lean Democrat.”

* **But the reality is that Garcia and the national GOP aren’t giving up that easily.** Over $12 MILLION in super PAC cash is hitting the airwaves to attack George and win over undecided voters.

Unlike Garcia, we’re keeping focus on this community. We’re on the ground connecting with the undecided voters we need to win, but the costs adds up:

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HlsSjTn0fsG0C3Zq6hii0g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-sqP0S_~)
---
| |
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HlsSjTn0fsG0C3Zq6hii0g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-sqP0S_~) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HlsSjTn0fsG0C3Zq6hii0g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-sqP0S_~) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/HlsSjTn0fsG0C3Zq6hii0g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-sqP0S_~)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Conservative Broadcast

The countdown is on—only 22 days until Election Day! This is our moment to make a difference by sending Drew Johnson to Congress, where his experience and vision can help tackle the issues that matter to all of us. But we need your voice to get the word out!

In these final days, every conversation counts. Talk to your friends, family, and neighbors about why Drew’s leadership is so important for our district and our country. And encourage them to get out and vote. With your help, we can create bring a positive change to Congress.

We’d also love to see you at two events this week:
* Tuesday Town Hall | October 15 | 6 - 7:30 PM | Drew For Nevada Campaign Office
* Meet and Greet | October 16 | 5 - 6:30 PM | Sun City Summerlin

Mark your calendar for “Tuesday Town Hall” - a meet-and-greet opportunity with Drew Johnson, CANDIDATE FOR U.S. CONGRESS. This is a great opportunity to hear directly from Drew about the issues that matter most to you! Drop in and out as your schedule allows.

Wednesday, October 16 | 5 - 6:30 PM. Sun City Summerlin (2701 Spalding Drive). Mark your calendar for a meet-and-greet opportunity with Drew Johnson, CANDIDATE FOR U.S. CONGRESS. This is a great opportunity to hear directly from Drew about the issues that matter most to you! Drop in and out as your schedule allows.

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/TJHFEE-vY5tIgaKOtkSp2g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-) [NO](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/TJHFEE-vY5tIgaKOtkSp2g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/TJHFEE-vY5tIgaKOtkSp2g~~/AARclAA~/RgRo7-)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. We are bringing both together as we near the end of this election, and I want you to be there for the concert of a lifetime. | | I am especially proud of this opportunity because it is personal to me. Music filled my home growing up. My mother would sing gospel music, my father was a lover of jazz, and I was raised on Aretha Franklin's "Young, Gifted, and Black" and came of age grooving to P-Funk. Music brings people together. Whether it is listening to a Miles Davis record, dancing to A Tribe Called Quest, or watching a Beyoncé performance with loved ones -- music transports us to a place of hope, community, and inspiration. That same spirit takes us to the ballot box, where we use our voices to shape our future. Voting is an essential part of our civic duty as Americans, and we must do everything in our power to make sure every voice is heard on Election Day. body:
This is our last chance to show the strength it will take to scare off additional spending from outside groups and Super PACs that can dump virtually unlimited sums of money into the race.
#

Peter -
It’s been a big week.
Ruben debated Kari Lake on October 9th.
That very same day, Arizona started voting.
Trump came to Arizona again yesterday. He came after Ruben again, and rallied his supporters behind Kari Lake.
And over the last few days, we’ve keyed in on one, critical number in the polling:
Ruben’s ahead, but around 10% of the electorate is undecided between Kari Lake and Ruben in Arizona’s U.S. Senate race.
That...is a massive problem. It’s far larger than Ruben’s lead, and far larger than most campaigns, historically, at this point in the race.
We don’t have much time to reach these undecided voters, and we've got even less time before our pre-general election FEC deadline, coming up this Wednesday, October 16th.
This is our last chance to show the strength it will take to scare off additional spending from outside groups and Super PACs that can dump virtually unlimited sums of money into the race. Money that could turn persuadable, undecided voters to Kari Lake.
Money that could defeat Ruben and hand Arizona over to Trump and Kari Lake.
It’s a make or break deadline. A win-lose moment.

body:

# **Your vote. Your power.**
---
|
---
| | | | In every election, we're reminded of a simple truth: democracy only works when we show up. Across the country, millions of Americans are standing at a crossroads. Extremists are chipping away at our freedoms—voter suppression laws, attempts to deny reproductive rights, and efforts to block healthcare for the most vulnerable. But here’s the thing: we are the majority. The only thing that stands between their vision for America and ours is turnout. We’re proud of our progress, but there's more work to be done. With so much on the line, every race matters. Every vote counts. Our opponents are betting on low turnout. They’re hoping you stay home. But we know you won’t. You know what's at stake. This is where No Dem Left Behind comes in. We are committed to turning out the vote in rural and working-class communities—places where people often feel left behind by the political system. Together, we can make sure that no voice goes unheard, no ballot goes uncast, and no race is unwinnable. Your support helps us keep boots on the ground, fight disinformation, and provide resources for those who need it most. Will you stand with us in this critical fight? [**_This election could be decided by just a handful of votes. If everyone donated just $24, we would be able to reach every community and drive out the vote like never seen before._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v2jlt-ffq5wk-kyd76rh9/)**__**[**_Together, we can secure a better future for all. | | Dear Fellow American,

My name is Larry P. Arnn, and I serve as president of Hillsdale College. I'm writing to you today because you're a concerned American who keeps up with current events.

That means you know something is seriously wrong in too many of our nation's schools.

You understand that a fierce ideological battle is raging in classrooms nationwide, and our children are at risk.

**This is no accident.**

The far-Left, guided by a Marxist vision of a radically transformed society, has strategically targeted education, including K-12 classrooms across America.

That's why I'm asking you to complete the [**NATIONAL OPINION SURVEY ON THE MARXIST HIJACKING OF AMERICAN EDUCATION**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=9f3fb6f090184f7f8bd6be2746d05831&_e=j4QD8V4RNiVFBHb9d09cXcV0nlFqV7Vq4ipDiMXuW8xfSJ3J_U73QThbSeGgSoWSwkI2DQRTBJQFuUILoxjQHOG7OZnqa1sHUDLSg7x0WoAoSIJj0qUrzpudDFnQitcrSq1wtfBqQbjTmsXNNbxgw1sqdyuafcIp66fz_dvVZsVNggWiItvr4e4x-rCAzFwfYFAJwhYAV9MVujw_Q8aKXbl4WrWZbvLMNEw1ixkLQ6oBi7NMwijAlPNpsG38Xufv6VC-2NfmH27QPdsPESD-CkIwntPxJxI5JB3C-f8gxtSBYNPzy610krEOgpX-qiHjNQfCx1Ipz6ppXBDrRV2pQT0G6E1Jh1BisW2Ba7QFIVuoddWTTm2eHcVHBqCXx8ChPf2isJJX0As9FiuXArGGt5697BjUIf418FdSLmF4wc3HXSiCa9nudaxECNJjlMr_).

You can complete your survey at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/marxist-hijacking-of-american-education-survey](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=9f3fb6f090184f7f8bd6be2746d05831&_e=j4QD8V4RNiVFBHb9d09cXcV0nlFqV7Vq4ipDiMXuW8xfSJ3J_U73QThbSeGgSoWSwkI2DQRTBJQFuUILoxjQHOG7OZnqa1sHUDLSg7x0WoAoSIJj0qUrzpudDFnQitcrSq1wtfBqQbjTmsXNNbxgw1sqdyuafcIp66fz_dvVZsVNggWiItvr4e4x-rCAzFwfYFAJwhYAV9MVujw_Q8aKXbl4WrWZbvLMNEw1ixkLQ6oBi7NMwijAlPNpsG38Xufv6VC-2NfmH27QPdsPESD-CuVxNRaV-GpyGeoNlljNvj6kv9HFEnU9H71fHBhEtHBMZbrcH-N5ZfDYQq6PYUflxwFJkzsJk_-1yJR7CghA3dqh0D9R4-dELHzPXbIlDLcq47_GnjIGlccFJhEdehD5H2j-QiQbVy5gTHonIIC9gQyNgClJ5PY2z63mbT2Z2c1i)

**Your participation right now could not be more urgent.**

Hearing directly from informed Americans like you will be a great help to us, as well as to policymakers and opinion leaders at all levels.

**You may be shocked by the extreme and false ideas being taught in far too many schools today, such as ...**
* _America was founded on slavery, not freedom, and is systematically racist to this day._

* _White supremacy was woven into America at its founding._

* _Capitalism and free enterprise are sources of poverty and injustice._

* _Americans are not equal citizens but instead belong to one of two groups: "oppressors" or "oppressed." _

* _There is a variety of genders, and gender is changeable._

* _Free speech is dangerous, and speech labeled as "misinformation" should be censored. _

Derek —

In a truly weird turn of events, Donald Trump came to Coachella,
California, for a campaign rally with less than 25 days to go in this
election.

And instead of focusing his speech on telling people what he’d do as
president, he spent a lot of his time attacking me in terms we only hear
from dictators.

Here’s just a small sample of what he said about yours truly:

“Sleazebag”

“Major lowlife”

“A bad person, a sick person”

Yet again, this is just more of the same attacks he throws at me every
chance he gets. Whether he’s at a rally in Iowa, Pennsylvania, Florida, or
right here in California, he just can’t stop thinking about me.

But that’s not all he said. He attacked California’s election integrity,
setting up future claims of election fraud when he inevitably loses our
state.

Even worse, he said as president, he would withhold aid to California in
an act of political retribution, in its effort to fight wildfires. Who
does that?

The worst thing he said was during an interview on Fox News when he stated
that opponents like me were “the enemy within” and that he may need to use
the military to go after us.

His constant attacks on me mean that I am doing my job. But when someone
tells you what they are going to do — especially someone as depraved as

$5000 – that's the maximum amount a corporate PAC can donate directly to a candidate **As you can imagine, raising $5000 at a time makes building a war chest like Brian Fitzpatrick's easy. So... why am I refusing to accept money from corporate PACs that can write these big checks?** Well, I didn't grow up rich. In fact, I remember pouring water on my cereal because my family couldn't afford milk sometimes. I joined the Army because it was a way to pay for college and build economic security for my future. I know what it's like to struggle. As do so many Pennsylvanians. Corporations on the other hand? They're raking in record profits while the rest of us pay more for housing, groceries, and other basic necessities. That’s why I'm not taking any corporate PAC money, because corporate interests already have enough representation in Congress. It's kids like me and working families like mine who need a voice championing them in Washington. **[So instead of taking big checks from already powerful groups, I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to give whatever they can. body:
Polling is too close for comfort.
---

That’s on top of a recent _New York Times_ poll that showed that if the election were held today, Trump would win Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina. It’s not great, Derek. And it shows that Trump and his allies’ constant attacks could be having a real impact. Dear Friend,
**I’m sorry**.
I’m sorry all these politicians constantly text, email, and send you letters asking for _fake 1000X donation matches_.
I’m sorry they feed you promises _they never intend to keep_.
I’m sorry for their lies and downright _betrayals of your trust_.
**Friend****, I understand why you don’t want to give them your hard-earned money, time, or support...**
You don’t need to be in Congress to see it:
* Politicians tell you they’ll do anything to stop the _illegal invasion_ , and then _vote for Biden’s Open Border Budget._

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Israel burned Palestinian patients alive in hospital tents
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Multiple major and gut-wrenching updates on Israel’s genocide and ethnic
cleansing in Gaza came out over the weekend,
Peter.

First, late last week a UN inquiry found that the Israeli government
purposefully targeted and destroyed Gaza’s healthcare infrastructure over
the past year, which constitutes a war crime. Remember when Western media
and the U.S. government denied Israel would ever bomb a hospital last
October?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241014-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241014-36068&akid=36068%2E1203867%2EQ_n0Yt ]Al Jazeera: BREAKING: A UN inquiry found that Israel implemented a
concerted policy to destroy Gaza’s healthcare system during its attacks,
which constitutes war crimes and the crime against humanity of
extermination.

Second, the Netanyahu administration told Haaretz that it is no longer
pursuing talks to free the hostages, and is instead planning to withhold
humanitarian aid — more than it already has for the last year, leaving
millions of Palestinians at risk of starvation — and annex portions of
Gaza. Any of the hundreds of thousands of Palestinian civilians who remain
in northern Gaza will be starved or killed.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241014-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241014-36068&akid=36068%2E1203867%2EQ_n0Yt ]Haaretz.com: Netanyahu’s government is not seeking to revive hostage
talks and the political leadership is pushing for the gradual annexation
of large parts of the Gaza Strip, senior defense officials tell Haaretz.
Assal Rad: He’s not “examining a plan,  no aid has gone in since Oct 1.
It’s not starving “out Hamas,” it’s starving civilians including children.
It’s not a plan that “could trap,” 400,000 people are already trapped with
nowhere to go. You’re supposed to cover war crimes not cover them up. The
Associated Press: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is examining a
plan to seal off humanitarian aid to northern Gaza in an attempt to starve
out Hamas militants, a plan that could trap hundreds of thousands of
Palestinians without food or water.

Third, the Israeli military bombed refugee tents outside of a hospital on
Sunday, burning children and other Palestinian patients alive — some
visibly hooked up to IVs and trapped in their beds. The images documenting
this cruel attack are nothing short of horrifying and will be an appalling
document of this genocide forever.

So what is the Biden Administration doing about it? It’s violating
international law by continuing to send BILLIONS of dollars in bombs and
weapons to Israel, and even sending U.S. troops to assist the Israeli
military, despite mounting evidence of Israel’s war crimes.

The United States is complicit in genocide and ethnic cleansing, and it
cannot continue, Peter. Israel
has violated international law repeatedly and will continue to do so until
Palestinians are completely wiped out, as long as the U.S. enables them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241014-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241014-36068&akid=36068%2E1203867%2EQ_n0Yt ]We have three words for the Biden Administration: Stop. Arming. Israel.
Add your name to demand an immediate arms embargo to stop this
annihilation NOW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241014-stop-arming-israel/?source=em20241014-36068&akid=36068%2E1203867%2EQ_n0Yt ]Add Your Name

We cannot look away or become complacent,
Peter. Our elected officials are enabling and
our tax dollars are funding this genocide. We must keep speaking up until
our leaders change course and hold Israel accountable for these crimes
against humanity.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1003&akid=36068%2E1203867%2EQ_n0Yt

All three of these things are important to me. I’m really proud to be a member of House Democratic leadership, and part of that means doing whatever I can to help build up our majority so we can get things done .
But nothing is more meaningful to me than making sure the people of my district – whether they vote for me or not – know they have someone looking out for them in Congress.
At the end of the day, that’s the entire point of what we’re doing! I got into public service because I believe we all deserve to have someone representing us who truly cares about our livelihoods, our opportunities, and our families.
So in that spirit, here’s a little of what’s been happening on the ground in San Diego in recent weeks:

[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4357586170634266366A656D39697A2F686F506A4E563945303049726248504273427A4E325168515968714A746B456D54524C65715A41547731796956346730/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202024-10-14%20at%201.12.15%20PM.png]

[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4357586170634266366A656D39697A2F686F506A4E563945303049726248504273427A4E325168515968714A746B456D54524C65715A41547731796956346730/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202024-10-14%20at%201.12.22%20PM.png]

I stopped by the Unite Here Local 30 picket line in downtown San Diego to talk with workers and drop off some sweet treats (from one of my favorite spots, Rose Donuts!). I’m always proud to stand in solidarity with workers fighting for better treatment.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4357586170634266366A656D39697A2F686F506A4E563945303049726248504273427A4E325168515968714A746B456D54524C65715A41547731796956346730/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202024-10-14%20at%201.12.37%20PM.png]
And our new yard signs came in! If you’d like to display one in your yard, you can add your name online and we’ll be in touch to drop one off to you . [https://sarajacobsforca.com/get-involved] (Fun fact – my mom personally delivers our yard signs to supporters. Thanks, Mom!)

I’m honored to serve my district in Congress and I don’t take this job for granted for a single second. So if you can, please consider contributing to my re-election campaign so I can keep up this work and make sure I deliver a strong victory against my extreme MAGA opponent. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Thanks for speaking up with me.
-Sara

And Democratic governors are the backstop against extremist agendas that would send us backward on protecting reproductive rights and tackling climate change. So, I’m writing to tell you about what’s at stake in the New Hampshire Governor’s race:
1. Democrat Joyce Craig is up against Trump-endorser Kelly Ayotte.
2. Joyce is being outspent 2:1 on the airwaves thanks to the GOP’s ultra-rich donors.

body:

Friends,
If you need another reason to get fired up about kicking Jim Jordan out of Congress, here it is:
Jim Jordan co-sponsored the Life at Conception Act – a bill that would implement a national abortion ban WITH NO EXCEPTIONS.
If you want to know what that would mean for you, let’s take a look at what’s already happening around the country:
In Georgia, Amber Thurman died when doctors delayed emergency care out of fear of violating Georgia’s extreme abortion ban. This month, a Georgia judge struck down that ban, calling it exactly what it is – forced labor.
But of course, the Georgia Supreme Court swooped in and put that decision on hold, putting more women at risk while the state appeals.
It’s infuriating!
Texas Republicans got a big present from SCOTUS when Trump’s conservative justices upheld a state law that stops doctors from providing life-saving emergency care to pregnant women. Unbelievable, right?
And it’s not just “red states” either! In California, a private hospital recently denied a woman having a miscarriage the emergency abortion she needed. They sent her out the door to another hospital 20 miles away with a bucket and some towels “in case something happened”!
This is already our reality with the overturning of Roe . But if Jim Jordan gets his way it’s going to be so much worse!
This is why this is the most important congressional race in the country. We must restore Roe and codify it nationwide, which means flipping the House and kicking anti-woman extremists like Jim Jordan to the curb.
We just raised $2 MILLION from people all across the country who are sick and tired of Jordan’s hypocrisy and chaos. Will you pitch in $25, $100, $1000 or even $3300 to help us hit $3 million so we can double down on our media blitz to fire Jim Jordan on November 5th? If Jim Jordan, the biggest ULTRA-MAGA clown in Congress, keeps his seat and gains the House Speakership, then we are headed down a dark, dystopian path.
He’s ready to push his Handmaid’s Tale agenda under Project 2025, and we’ve got to shut him down.
Jim Jordan doesn’t want women making their own choices, and he’s ready to turn back the clock on our rights.
Well, not on our watch! We’re the campaign that’s got him running scared, and with your help, we can end his political career AND flip the House.
People are joining forces with us coast to coast to take Jim Jordan down. It’s so exciting to see our movement growing, we’ve got the momentum to take this all the way and it’s amazing!
Rush a donation of $25, $50, or even $100 right now to ensure we have the resources we need to finish what we’ve started. Your support means we can reach every last voter and get our message out. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241014_repro_rights_update_link2]
It’s time to make history, bring some common sense back to Congress, and END this constant turmoil from chaos agents like Jim Jordan.

Donate now, and let’s show Jim Jordan what happens when you mess with women’s rights!

Tamie Wilson

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **
