name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – October 14th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election
day!
*Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote!*

*SPECIAL REQUESTS*

*Block walking *
*this Saturday! This will be with normal turfs like we have been doing
through the Summer. Please come and join the fun. No experience
necessary. We’ll be meeting at 9 am at the WinCo Foods in Lewisville at
Main and Old Orchard. Details and signup at Mobilize:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/727161/
<https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/727161/>*

*Poll Greeting** gives voters that last show of confidence in their
candidate. We’re still developing a plan along with the Denton County
Democratic Party. Let us know what days you can be available and what part
of town is best for you. If you can play a role to help organize, even
better!*

*Shirts**; We still have some Lineberger light blue T-shirts left. Perfect
for Poll Greeters, Door knockers, etc. Inventory now is S - 2, L – 12, XL
– 7. No charge, just wear with pride and share the message.*

*Signs, Signs, Signs*
*; Signs at the polling location! This is a very easy job. Wait for the
day before the election. Go to the polling place and place the signs.
Check on the signs a few times to make sure they stay in place. Pick the
signs up when it’s all over. We have a Signup Genius already prepared for
59 Early voting locations including one in Cooke County and several in Wise
County. Only 24 Spots left!! (Thank You!). *Sign Volunteers: Lineberger
for US Congress - Polling Location Sign Placement and Pickup
(signupgenius.com)
<https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B4BAAAD2FA1FACF8-51480094-lineberger#/>

*The idea is to sign up for a location (or more) not far from you. We also
have sign up open for area coordinators to help people get signs and answer
questions. We may even ask you to install a sign or two for other
candidates at the same polling location. And remember, for early voting,
people can vote anywhere in the county.*

I still have about 50 yard signs in stock in my house. So, hopefully most
of the 700 signs are out and winning friends and influencing people. If
you have extra signs lying around, now is the time to get them all out so
people can see them, learn the name, get curious and look it up, etc. If
you have too many, let us know.

Thank you so much to the teams who have been placing signs. It’s fun to
see them out there.

*Social media Support needed sharing the message*; Since we have such a
huge district and won’t be able to personally call or knock on everyone’s
doors, we are trying to find new ways of getting my name out there and
letting people know they’ll have a ‘Better Choice’ this year for Congress.

We are asking that you please follow "Lineberger for US Congress" on
Facebook. You can also search my name on Twitter (ErnestForTexas),
Instagram (linebergerforuscongress), and/or Tik Tok (@ernestlineberger),
whichever social media platforms you follow. We post several items and
videos each week and would appreciate it if you would “like them” and then
“share them” with your friends. Some of you may also have neighborhood
social media platforms where you can share political views, this would also
be a great way to get the word out.

I know some people may be hesitant to do this, but it’s one of the best
ways to multiply our message by a huge amount. Multiplying our efforts to
spread the word is truly the only way we will win. This is such an
important election; I hope you’ll commit to doing that for the next 30 days
or until Election Day.

*All of this to try to reach our 300,000-vote win number.*
Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach
out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure
people that we are for real. *When that opportunity comes your way, make
it count*!

Here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to the election.

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 9 – 11 am, LISD PTA Candidate forum, 2553 FM 544,
Lewisville
This is for TX House and Senate candidates, but I plan to go,
support, see and be seen.

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 5:30 – 8:30 pm, Prestonwood Candidate Forum and Mixer,
6801 W Park Blvd, Plano
This is a big event – in person and Live streamed. Meet & greet
in the Atrium 5:30 – 6:15 pm.
6:15 pm move to the Student Ministry Building for the forum, 6:30
– 8:30, but I should be one of the first

*Tuesday, Oct 15th*, 7 pm, Colin Allred – Ted Cruz senatorial Debate on WFAA
I’ll miss most of this due to the Prestonwood event above. Find
a watch party and have fun!

*Wednesday, Oct 16th*, 6;45 pm, Flower Mound Area Democrats General Meeting
1720 S Edmonds Ln, Lewisville

*Thursday, Oct 17th*, 11 am – 1:30, Cooke County Health Forum, Knights of
Columbus, 403 N Oak St, Muenster

*Saturday, Oct 19th*, 9 am – noon, Block Walk, Lewisville, Meeting at WinCo
Foods at Main and Old Orchard
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/727161/

*Saturday, Oct 19th*, 1 – 3 pm, Heroes, Cops and Kids Community GOTV Event,
We’ll have a table/booth.
Aldersgate United Methodist Church, 3926 Old Denton Road,
Carrollton

*Saturday, Oct 19th*, 3-9 pm, DeVali Festival, Gerault park, Flower Mound,
We’ll just be enjoying the fun.

*Sunday, Oct 20th*, morning, We’ll visit another church in the district to
get to know the community

*Monday, Oct 21st*, 7 am, Early Voting Begins!!! - *Poll Greeting daily
(Will need lots of help to staff the major polling sites) *

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking TBD

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton

clean_body: Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress! October 21st marks the start of early voting. November 5th is election day! Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote! SPECIAL REQUESTS Block walking this Saturday! This will be with normal turfs like we have been doing through the Summer. Please come and join the fun. No experience necessary. We’ll be meeting at 9 am at the WinCo Foods in Lewisville at Main and Old Orchard. Details and signup at Mobilize: <> Poll Greeting gives voters that last show of confidence in their candidate. We’re still developing a plan along with the Denton County Democratic Party. Let us know what days you can be available and what part of town is best for you. If you can play a role to help organize, even better! Shirts; We still have some Lineberger light blue T-shirts left. Perfect for Poll Greeters, Door knockers, etc. Inventory now is S - 2, L – 12, XL – 7. No charge, just wear with pride and share the message. Signs, Signs, Signs ; Signs at the polling location! This is a very easy job. Wait for the day before the election. Go to the polling place and place the signs. Check on the signs a few times to make sure they stay in place. Pick the signs up when it’s all over. We have a Signup Genius already prepared for 59 Early voting locations including one in Cooke County and several in Wise County. Only 24 Spots left!! (Thank You!). Sign Volunteers: Lineberger for US Congress - Polling Location Sign Placement and Pickup (signupgenius.com) <> The idea is to sign up for a location (or more) not far from you. We also have sign up open for area coordinators to help people get signs and answer questions. We may even ask you to install a sign or two for other candidates at the same polling location. And remember, for early voting, people can vote anywhere in the county. I still have about 50 yard signs in stock in my house. So, hopefully most of the 700 signs are out and winning friends and influencing people. If you have extra signs lying around, now is the time to get them all out so people can see them, learn the name, get curious and look it up, etc. If you have too many, let us know. Thank you so much to the teams who have been placing signs. It’s fun to see them out there. Social media Support needed sharing the message; Since we have such a huge district and won’t be able to personally call or knock on everyone’s doors, we are trying to find new ways of getting my name out there and letting people know they’ll have a ‘Better Choice’ this year for Congress. We are asking that you please follow "Lineberger for US Congress" on Facebook. You can also search my name on Twitter (ErnestForTexas), Instagram (linebergerforuscongress), and/or Tik Tok (@ernestlineberger), whichever social media platforms you follow. We post several items and videos each week and would appreciate it if you would “like them” and then “share them” with your friends. Some of you may also have neighborhood social media platforms where you can share political views, this would also be a great way to get the word out. I know some people may be hesitant to do this, but it’s one of the best ways to multiply our message by a huge amount. Multiplying our efforts to spread the word is truly the only way we will win. This is such an important election; I hope you’ll commit to doing that for the next 30 days or until Election Day. All of this to try to reach our 300,000-vote win number. Hopefully, after seeing my name in a few places, more people will reach out to you and us for those healthy, convincing conversations that reassure people that we are for real. **It’s Time for a Change:****The Case Against Susan Wild**
Friends,
We all know it’s time for a change here in the Lehigh Valley and throughout our nation. You know the issues, and you understand why they’re so important. But we want to make sure that as you have conversations with voters in these closing weeks, you have all the facts about Susan Wild and her incredibly long track record of insults, lies, and deceit. That’s why we’re sending you this — **the official case against Susan Wild**.
It’s our hope that you share some of these facts with your family, friends, and co-workers ahead of next month’s critical election. Make sure that the people in your life know the truth about the two candidates in this race. And, as always, for the facts about Ryan’s record of common sense and bipartisan accomplishments, please check out our [website](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=0e36810cf0&e=5ccada9200).
**WHO IS SUSAN WILD:**
**100% Pro-Biden Voting Record** According to independent vote tracking, Susan Wild was voting with Joe Biden [100%](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=dee025a63f&e=5ccada9200) of the time - including for every plank of Bidenomics, his America last energy agenda, and his open-borders policies.
**Voted Against a Border Wall 10 Times** Despite now trying to sound tough on border security, Susan Wild has consistently opposed any meaningful attempt to secure the border and called the idea of a wall “silly.” Watch Here: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=COoWMz2adsc](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=c511879721&e=5ccada9200)
**Supports Sanctuary Cities and Called them “Safer”** Susan Wild is on the record supporting sanctuary cities, and even unbelievably asserted that they were “safer” than other cities. Watch Here: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WuLP8bq1dQw](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=b72604b8fc&e=5ccada9200)
**Supports Taxpayer Paid Benefits for Illegals** Susan Wild voted to give $125 Billion in taxpayer paid benefits to illegal immigrants- benefits we don’t get. Wild even supports full amnesty for those here illegally.
**Supported Massive New Taxes on American Energy, Including Fracking** Susan Wild’s radical [plan](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=1aff3ac340&e=5ccada9200) would have put new taxes on fossil fuels — including coal, oil, and natural gas — that would automatically increase every year, meaning even higher energy bills and gas prices. She also supported new taxes on fracking that would have destroyed the industry in PA and left hundreds of thousands of Pennsylvanians out of work.
**Supports Biden’s Ban on Gas-Powered Cars** Susan Wild voted against a bill that would have stopped Joe Biden’s radical plan to ban gas-powered cars - driving up prices and reducing choices for every American.
**Messing With Medicare** Susan Wild’s plan to improve Medicare has fallen apart. Part D premiums have [skyrocketed](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=f7e89366fc&e=5ccada9200) in Pennsylvania, and now the federal government is raiding the Medicare Trust Fund to give away massive subsidies to giant insurance companies to try and keep premiums steady in an election year.
**Lying About Ryan Mackenzie’s IVF & Abortion Positions**Susan Wild was caught lying about Ryan Mackenzie and his stance on IVF and abortion. Read more [here](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=c9ad738fb2&e=5ccada9200).
**Extreme Abortion Position** While Susan Wild has been lying about Ryan’s abortion position and calling it “extreme,” Susan Wild is the real extremist — she is on the record opposing any limitation on abortion, even at the end of a pregnancy. She also supports taxpayer funding for late-term and partial-birth abortion. What’s even crazier: Wild was the keynote [speaker](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=8f55a1c525&e=5ccada9200) for an event with Population Connection, an extremist organization dedicated to population control and the use of taxpayer funded abortion in order to achieve it.
**Lying About Ryan Mackenzie’s Social Security/Medicare Positions** Susan Wild has falsely alleged that Ryan Mackenzie would “put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block.” Ryan Mackenzie has vowed to protect Medicare and Social Security, and he is committed to eliminating the tax on social security. Meanwhile, Susan Wild has driven up premiums for Medicare recipients and raided the Medicare Trust Fund.
**Supporting Illegal Immigrants Voting in U.S. Elections** Susan Wild voted [against](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=585687854c&e=5ccada9200) the SAVE ACT, a bill which would have made it more difficult for illegal immigrants and non-citizens to vote in US elections.
**Supporting Pro-Hamas Radicals** On Susan Wild’s birthday, she [raised](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=459fd033a3&e=5ccada9200) funds for a far-left organization that supports Hamas.
**Taking Both Sides of Israel-Gaza Issue** Susan Wild sent two different letters with [contradictory](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=a711e3aa40&e=5ccada9200) messages about the Israel-Gaza conflict.
**Siding With The Squad** Susan Wild has taken tens of thousands of [dollars](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=e6947aeca5&e=5ccada9200) from members of “The Squad,” Congress’s most radical members, including those who support the Defund The Police movement
**Lying About Being Bi-Partisan** Susan Wild loves to say she is bipartisan but was [caught](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=6a1741ac97&e=5ccada9200) lying this week about her record.
**Disparaged Carbon County** Susan Wild has repeatedly insulted Carbon County voters, saying she was “dismayed” to represent them because they “drank the Trump kool aid” and that she needed to “school” them over it. Read more [here](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=80fce9b458&e=5ccada9200).
**Disparaged a Veteran on Memorial Day** After a flag bearer at a Memorial Day event refused to shake her hand, Susan Wild took to Facebook to [impugn](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=777b501520&e=5ccada9200) his character and imply that the man was a bigot.
**Ignored Veterans** Susan Wild has been repeatedly [called out](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=f85c593bec&e=5ccada9200) for skipping events with veterans and ignoring their needs.
**$775 in Unpaid Tickets and Parking in Handicapped Spots** Recently Susan Wild was caught with a boot on her car for not paying $775 in unpaid fines. She was also caught parking in handicap parking spaces without authorization. Read More[ here](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=93800accad&e=5ccada9200).
**Reckless Driving** Susan Wild was [caught](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=b5786d1982&e=5ccada9200) speaking on a Zoom video call while driving. This episode was denounced by several driver safety advocates, with one calling her actions “stupid as hell.”
**Fake Supporters** Recently, Susan Wild was [caught](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=8b9a83cb12&e=5ccada9200) paying people to attend her rallies.
**Fake Police Officer** Susan Wild’s allies decided to have a [fake](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=98b6b271cf&e=5ccada9200) police officer appear in an ad thanking Wild for her “support” for the police. The Fraternal Order of Police - a group that endorsed Ryan Mackenzie - called her out for this.

_Aloha Peter, this is Mazie. Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is running for Senate in Florida, and she needs our help. Please read this message from her campaign, and [split a donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95017187/505306631/2045323570?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241014_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyN2VjZC03MDhhLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnnKfvPQsYZrJ1OiNfBR5AWUo__rNaYJSYYdqWqybeY=) between our campaigns if you can. * * *
This is one of the biggest and most personally meaningful moments in our race for Florida's Senate seat. **Former President Barack Obama just endorsed me!** To have the support from President Obama is a humbling moment. I was proud to volunteer for his campaign in 2008 and 2012, and I’m so proud to have his support in mine. He is a true public servant and a determined campaigner who has fought hard to better our nation. He believes in the grassroots movement we've built, Peter — a movement that includes you. Together, with Barack Obama fighting alongside us, we will defeat Rick Scott and protect our Democratic Senate majority! And today, my campaign is proud to launch an ad featuring President Obama speaking to the importance of our race. **[You can watch that ad here — I hope you love it as much as I do.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95017188/505306632/1261861794?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241014_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyN2VjZC03MDhhLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnnKfvPQsYZrJ1OiNfBR5AWUo__rNaYJSYYdqWqybeY=&emci=f0cb277f-578a-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=90227ecd-708a-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=23190490)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95017189/505306633/2045323570?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241014_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDIyN2VjZC03MDhhLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnnKfvPQsYZrJ1OiNfBR5AWUo__rNaYJSYYdqWqybeY=) This endorsement will fuel a huge amount of momentum, but we cannot rest on our laurels for a second. In fact, President Obama's endorsement and belief in this race is a signal for us to work even harder. Because right now, polls show me in a statistical tie with Rick Scott, but he's already spent $37 MILLION on ads to defeat me. President Obama knows the power of a grassroots movement — the power that people like you have when they make a donation in the name of hope and change. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
It's not too late to honor our Navy heroes.
As someone whose brother served in the U.S. Navy, our sailors are particularly close to my heart. My brother served on the USS Durham for four years and was recognized with the Sea Service Deployment Ribbon, Southwest Asia Service Medal and National Defense Service Medal.
I've seen the sacrifices they make, from spending long months isolated at sea to missing holidays with their loved ones. **That 's why I was so disappointed to see we fell short of our signature goal for the Navy's birthday. **
With just a few hours left until our extended deadline, I noticed you still haven't added your name, so I wanted to personally reach out with one last reminder. **[Will you sign our Navy birthday card now to honor our sailors and all who serve?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[SIGN THE CARD](https://links.e.uso.)

Thank you, Secretary Haaland!

clean_body: You can make a difference! | Join a call with the Settle Campaign Ever wonder what it's like to run for office across Pennsylvania? With just over 3 weeks left, it the perfect time to get any questions you have answered. | "Join the Call 10/14 7pm" We've rescheduled this call to 7pm so we can all hop over the the National Meet the Forwardists call hosted by Andrew Yang at 8. We'd love for you to join us for that too. Just RSVP to get the meeting link. The Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising chest. Now, they've just dumped $5.5 million into Montana, and are set on defeating me.

At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.
**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump 's Secretary of the Interior and I was a ground forces commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I 'm also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**
But if the Democrats can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.
**In 2022, I led the team of Navy SEALs that retook the House Majority, and I have more conflict experience than anyone else. Point is, I 'm one of the toughest, well-tested Republicans in Washington D.C. If I can't beat the Democrats going after my seat - no one can.**

subject: Indigenous rights are human rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
This is a fight for our soul as much as our collective survival.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=indigenous_justice&n=1)
---
Peter,

As we mark Indigenous Peoples Day, it’s important that we tell the truth about our past, our present, and our path forward.

And the truth is that from the moment the first European boats touched these shores, to the continued assault on tribal sovereignty today, there has never been a day in this nation’s history that wasn’t steeped in the blood and suffering of Indigenous peoples.

The truth is that America became the richest and most powerful nation on Earth by stealing land, stealing natural resources, stealing labor – and savagely murdering anyone who got in the way of that pursuit.

**The truth is that our fight to stop climate change is inextricably linked with the fight for Indigenous justice – and no one who continues to trample on the sovereign rights of Native peoples can be trusted to take the climate emergency seriously.

** We know all about the way Donald Trump aggressively auctioned off drilling permits for public lands and sacred tribal grounds without consulting the impacted tribes.

But little is said about Biden continuing many of those same policies – bragging about issuing more drilling permits than any other administration in history and handing out mining contracts on Native land without consulting tribal leaders.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=indigenous_justice&n=2)
---
And while Harris promised, in her first weeks of campaigning, that she will _“always honor tribal sovereignty and respect tribal self-determination,”_ her record as California’s attorney general screams a different story.

Harris repeatedly opposed recognition of tribal lands, supported regulations that harmed tribal casinos and economic self-determination, and oversaw the largest carceral system in the United States where Indigenous Americans are disproportionately imprisoned.

With this track record, and her service in the Biden administration, Native American voters have every reason to be skeptical – and they are.

And the truth is that from the moment the first European boats touched these shores, to the continued assault on tribal sovereignty today, there has never been a day in this nation’s history that wasn’t steeped in the blood and suffering of Indigenous peoples. The truth is that America became the richest and most powerful nation on Earth by stealing land, stealing natural resources, stealing labor – and savagely murdering anyone who got in the way of that pursuit. The truth is that our fight to stop climate change is inextricably linked with the fight for Indigenous justice – and no one who continues to trample on the sovereign rights of Native peoples can be trusted to take the climate emergency seriously. We know all about the way Donald Trump aggressively auctioned off drilling permits for public lands and sacred tribal grounds without consulting the impacted tribes. But little is said about Biden continuing many of those same policies – bragging about issuing more drilling permits than any other administration in history and handing out mining contracts on Native land without consulting tribal leaders. And while Harris promised, in her first weeks of campaigning, that she will “always honor tribal sovereignty and respect tribal self-determination,” her record as California’s attorney general screams a different story. You might not know this about me, Peter:

**In 2009, I was selected by President Obama to help lead NASA as the Chief of Staff. It was an honor to work alongside him.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95019199/505313325/2104826962?refcode=em-10.14.24-2-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDkxZjZlZS03NzhhLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q7SRxoFypeqetaaAzx3piCLp4T7eZQUgvvhdgf45F6o=)
Working at NASA was nothing like the chaos we’re witnessing in Congress today. At NASA, we put petty politics and self-interest aside to solve problems for the American people. We left our differences at the door and banded together to leave our work better than we found it.

We’re sorely missing that selfless spirit in Congress, and Mike Garcia is one of the worst offenders.

He places his own interests ahead of our community, and would rather stick with the far-right reaches of his own party instead of working toward bipartisan solutions that would benefit us all.

The proof isn’t hard to see. His support for a national abortion ban, shady stock dealings lining his own pockets, vote to decertify the 2020 election results, the list goes on.

Voters see it, too. He’s one of the most vulnerable members of Congress, and polls show we have a narrow lead going into the final push before Election Day.

Right now, it's hard not to think about how this all began.
| | |
---
Friend, I know I'm sending you a lot of incredibly urgent emails about my race in Nevada these days. **But today, I want to take a step back and share the story of how I first got involved in politics.**
In 2016, while I was serving as the president of my synagogue in Nevada, Senator Harry Reid recruited me to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
_**The Cook Political Report**_**has been calling Nevada the “most perilous" battleground for Democrats. And as we enter the final stretch of this race, polls now show me losing crucial ground to my extreme MAGA opponent – right as**** Nevadans are set to begin mailing in their early ballots.**

MY BOLD, WIN-WIN PLAN
Our Agricultural Policy is Broken–
It Doesn’t Have to Be
Dear Peter,
America’s current agricultural policy is destroying our health, our land, and our family farms.
It’s squeezing small and mid-sized farmers out of business, while corporate giants thrive. Harmful chemicals pollute our soil and water, eventually making their way into our bodies.
And the USDA dietary guidelines? They’re skewed by corporate interests, _pushing ultra-processed foods that now make up 70% of the American diet_.
But it doesn’t have to be this way.
[Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_14_24_all_1&n=5)
[**I’m ready to implement a bold, win-win plan with President Trump’s administration**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_14_24_all_1&n=6) – a plan that puts family farmers, consumers, and our environment first. Here’s what I envision:
* **Empowering Farmers:** We’ll rewrite regulations to give family farmers a fair shot, level the playing field, and encourage sustainable practices that rebuild soil and replenish aquifers.
* **Banning Toxic Chemicals:** I’ll work to ban harmful agricultural chemicals already prohibited in other countries, so farmers can grow without poisoning our land, water, and bodies.
* **Fixing USDA Guidelines:** We’re going to restore integrity to dietary guidelines by removing conflicts of interest, ensuring Americans have access to natural, unprocessed foods.

I’ve seen what America’s innovative, regenerative farmers are already doing – greening deserts, revitalizing soils, and even replenishing water sources that have been dry for decades.
**Imagine if our government stopped fighting against these solutions and started embracing them.**
That’s the future I’m fighting for.
But time is running out.
[Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_14_24_all_1&n=7)
We have **22 days** to make this plan a reality, and we need every dollar for the final push. **Will you stand with me today?** Your support now can help us transform our food system and make America healthy again.
[**Please donate whatever you can – we’re counting on you.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-usda?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=usda_10_14_24_all_1&n=8)
Make America Healthy Again and restore power to the people instead of corporations.

It’s squeezing small and mid-sized farmers out of business, while corporate giants thrive. Harmful chemicals pollute our soil and water, eventually making their way into our bodies. And the USDA dietary guidelines? They’re skewed by corporate interests, pushing ultra-processed foods that now make up 70% of the American diet. But it doesn’t have to be this way. – a plan that puts family farmers, consumers, and our environment first. Here’s what I envision: Empowering Farmers: We’ll rewrite regulations to give family farmers a fair shot, level the playing field, and encourage sustainable practices that rebuild soil and replenish aquifers. Banning Toxic Chemicals: I’ll work to ban harmful agricultural chemicals already prohibited in other countries, so farmers can grow without poisoning our land, water, and bodies. Fixing USDA Guidelines: We’re going to restore integrity to dietary guidelines by removing conflicts of interest, ensuring Americans have access to natural, unprocessed foods. I’ve seen what America’s innovative, regenerative farmers are already doing – greening deserts, revitalizing soils, and even replenishing water sources that have been dry for decades. Imagine if our government stopped fighting against these solutions and started embracing them. That’s the future I’m fighting for. But time is running out. We have 22 days to make this plan a reality, and we need every dollar for the final push. Making dinner and taking calls before my evening events — that's just the reality of being a working mom, friend!

But here's what I also don't take for granted, friend: dinners at home with my three kids and husband, Sundays playing dominoes with my mom, and conversations with my children about what's been going on at school.
I love being a parent. But parents all over our nation — perhaps you, too, friend — share the same sinking feeling right now: Our kids are growing up in a country with fewer freedoms than we had at their age.

_I'm in this race to protect, restore, and defend our freedoms. To preserve our democracy. _

My opponent, Sen. Rick Scott, is directly responsible for confirming Supreme Court justices who have eviscerated reproductive rights and weakened voting rights. **_Ya no más — enough is enough._**

Derek — When I
first swore my oath of office as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I vowed to
defend our country from threats both foreign and domestic.

But never did I expect to be called an enemy of our country — but that’s
what Donald Trump just said about me.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241014_PM2_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7887%2E5257348%2Evki65J ]Donald Trump attacking Adam Schiff on Fox News

On Fox News yesterday morning, Donald Trump said that I am more dangerous
than our foreign adversaries in China and Russia. And the same is true of
anyone who stands up to him.

Peter – I just wrapped up my debate with Martin Heinrich, and what we saw was astounding.

He continues to lie and deflect away from his failed record and radical policies, and it’s exactly why we need your continued support to ensure voters know the TRUTH.

Now, we’re pushing forward and working to convert this debate into momentum for our campaign, and I need your help.

[**Propel us forward and help us continue reaching voters during these final few weeks by clicking here and chipping in anything you can today.**](http://links.nellanewmexico.com/u/click?_t=bec4f693b6284a4ba56cb04ba05e5b45&_m=0cd1670391984d81a450dcd77ee8bc74&_e=tsjmE5bIeKM7VT5er-8gfJ2TyNc4XVlH16QRCLPscEzgKH6BDLeFgS9cF7LCRjVgyhdn2nHcviNkwIYE5Oh-nj8-zHgGsxZSnBtcsPQxBuvL1wMBHEnWo1qE54oaVwpR6MvQaiCTefPDo_fTCyJQtep8NGnTMfzNAPjGyQ0RrJfn3nhLLp9zO12TmjquKkP1pgLXIidfaWMwI0aWY4GdHU6MXi-wJxzoSEJkBV-neFiIshY_BiVpSCOxSi8gJDvjQ0WnU_iRREta5ye-G4AMdreP_i7LY4lmPjUR2w4KBu44mxtb6d7as7gnPUaZiCwBkqD9IQErMkBXxhKiBfom-BSVMdgQoIdJTozyzV72pb2Q3_yENgLLO8lL0wojMdsko5u1ar3XdM16UbeMbYiwUpHLVciJR20CmTFDQp0h0Ek%3D)

**Let’s go fire Martin Heinrich and win!**

--Nella

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. subject: Why I got into public service

body:
I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

| Hi Peter — I have a personal story I’d like to share with you.

Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.

When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, wanted to make sure I was protected in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find any insurance policies that would cover me in the future.

_Not from any insurer. Not at any price._

That meant my grandparents had to pay for my health care out of pocket, and they had to make significant sacrifices to do so — all because I had a pre-existing condition.

I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried that I might fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care.

No one should ever have to go through that. But my story is not unique, Peter, and I knew they weren’t the only ones. **That’s why I got into public service.**

I’m one of 133 million Americans who have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to our care — and before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.

Now, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and wrote the amendment to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. And when I meet with young people across Wisconsin, _almost every hand in the room goes up when I ask who is on their parent’s health insurance._

So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care and threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — **including my opponent Eric Hovde, who called my amendment a “stupid idea” and said young people on their parent’s health insurance need to “grow up and move on.”**

If Eric Hovde flips this seat and secures the Senate majority for Republicans, the ACA will be on the chopping block and countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies are putting profits over people.

That’s not right. And that’s why I need your help to defeat him.

[_**I’ve fought against Republicans’ efforts to repeal the ACA before, and I won’t back down now.
